ANSWERED by m1. The full aligner rescues FOUR OF THE FIVE. Net contribution of the synonym table to the full aligner: ONE paraphrase of seven, not half the cases. Sensory -- the case the original report leaned on hardest -- hits WITHOUT the table once predicate, entity, granularity, structural and the HSMM transitions run.

So layer 4 of the hand-authorship stack is much thinner than the lexical measurement implied. Baseline document amended at e5076bf with the correction and with m1's own metric caveat: uniform top-5 source hit versus the suite's per-case assertions (subtreeMass for Vague, segment-level for Summary, Distorted-state for foils).

Procedural finding worth keeping: m1 did not need the reserved file. READING was never reserved, only editing. It copied the canonicalisation verbatim and ran both arms. An hour was spent waiting for a release that was never required.
